cards.example: Using reusable bags can reduce plastic waste.

cards.extra1: reusable (adj) — có thể tái sử dụng
cards.example: We can reuse glass jars instead of throwing them away.

cards.extra1: aware (adj) — nhận thức được; ý thức được
cards.extra2: raise awareness of/about — nâng cao nhận thức về
cards.example: Schools can raise awareness of environmental problems.

cards.extra2: protect the environment — bảo vệ môi trường
cards.example: Everyone has a role in protecting the environment.
Plastic pollution is a serious environmental problem.
Reducing traffic can help lower air pollution.
Factories can pollute rivers if waste is not treated properly.

cards.extra1: reduce plastic waste — giảm rác thải nhựa
cards.example: Reusable products can help reduce plastic waste.

cards.extra1: greenhouse gas emissions — lượng khí thải nhà kính
cards.example: Burning fossil fuels produces greenhouse gases.

cards.extra1: fight / address climate change — ứng phó với biến đổi khí hậu
cards.example: Climate change affects people and ecosystems around the world.
A greener lifestyle can reduce our impact on the environment.

cards.extra1: have an impact on — có tác động đến
cards.extra2: environmental impact — tác động môi trường
cards.example: Daily choices can have an impact on the environment.

cards.extra2: renewable energy source — nguồn năng lượng tái tạo
cards.example: Solar energy is a clean source of power.

cards.backContent: sự chú ý; sự quan tâm
cards.extra1: pay attention to — chú ý đến
cards.extra2: draw attention to — thu hút sự chú ý đến
cards.example: We should pay attention to how much waste we produce.

cards.extra2: environmental protection — bảo vệ môi trường
cards.example: Environmental protection requires action from everyone.
